verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents a first-party bulk capability: Managed Scans let you bulk onboard and scan many repositories without changing CI. The --autofix flag also applies rule-defined fixes to files a scan matches. Bulk actions on findings themselves (mass triage, ignore, assign or ticketing) are not evidenced, and the API is only described as listing findings and projects. Missing for 10: bulk triage or bulk updates of findings via UI or API, documented bulk endpoints or batch limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: consider Semgrep Managed Scans, which enables you to bulk onboard and scan your repositories without requiring changes to your CI
You can apply the Rule-defined fix directly to the file using the `--autofix` flag.
